title: Suggestions for improvement
body:
- possibility to sort by remind date/hour (not only by due date)
- possibility to chose that the completed tasks are auto-deleted on selected lists
- possibility to re-order by drag and drop
- possibility to add steps between existing steps or re-order

author: AstroSandu

title: Revive Wunderlist.
body:
Why is this worse than Wunderlist????

The list always jitters if it’s longer than the screen. 
The design is worse. 
You can’t just pick a task and put it on the bottom. 
The whole task moving UI is politely said badly executed. 

And that’s for one day of using this. 

Even though Wunderlist shut down a long time ago I kept using it. The only issue now is that arranging the tasks it automatically does it by creation date and it’s annoying. I won’t to have the list arranged after I get all the tasks in. Don’t know why it’s doing it now it never House did this before. 

So make this like Wunderlist or give me a shout on why I got this issue. 

Have a nice day. 
Serj.
